fix.onlyRuntimeChange: texture(bricks, uv).level(float(0)) in spoutShade replaces implicit-mip texture(bricks, uv); no shared runtime, timeout, image envelope or restore tolerance change.
fix.reason: Implicit derivatives are undefined in nonuniform control flow. One-variable sampling A/B removed the observed nondeterminism; no particular SwiftShader internal implementation mechanism is claimed.
fix.tradeoff: Explicit base mip changes distant brick filtering and can expose minification aliasing. Original GLSL snapshot remains byte-exact. Media and reference/performance/browser evidence regenerated.
fix.typeWrapperScope: The minimized A/B and six software repeats used the JavaScript-valid .level(0) precursor. Installed declarations require a Node, so final source uses .level(float(0)); both contain constant0 but are different node objects. Final-source media/evidence, full regression, quality, final isolated tests and CI are verified separately.

typeWrapper.meaning: Both explicitly select base mip0. float(0) adds a typed VarNode required by installed declarations; node identity and generated shader identity are not claimed. Full final-code regression is rerun separately.
